map.铬回收率(%) = (废液浓度 − 回收后浓度) ÷ 废液浓度 × 100%；回: Chromium recovery rate (%) = (waste concentration − post-recovery concentration) ÷ waste concentration × 100%; chromium recovered (kg) = (waste concentration − post-recovery concentration) × treated volume (L) ÷ 1,000,000 (concentration in mg/L). Grades: ≥90% excellent, ≥75% good, ≥50% average, otherwise poor. If the post-recovery concentration exceeds the waste concentration, the tool clamps it to no more than the original value.
map.废液铬浓度 2500 mg/L、处理后 400 mg/L：回收率 = (2500: Waste liquor chromium concentration 2500 mg/L, after treatment 400 mg/L: recovery rate = (2500−400)/2500×100 = 84%, rated good; with a treated volume of 5000 L the chromium recovered = 2100×5000/1e6 = 10.5 kg.
map.回收率和吸收率有什么区别？: What is the difference between recovery rate and uptake rate?
map.吸收率看鞣制工序中皮吸收了多少铬（减少用量与排放），回收率看末端治理从废液中回收: The uptake rate looks at how much chromium the hide absorbs during tanning (reducing dosage and discharge), while the recovery rate looks at how much chromium is recovered from the waste liquor at the end; the former is cleaner production and the latter is end-of-pipe resource recovery.
map.回收率越高越好吗？: Is a higher recovery rate always better?
map.技术上越高越有利于减排与资源回收，但需权衡药剂与能耗成本；应结合处理成本与排放标: Technically higher is better for emission reduction and resource recovery, but reagent and energy costs have to be weighed in; set an economically feasible target recovery rate by combining treatment cost and emission standards.
